Definition: probably of foreign derivation; Dalmatia, a region of Europe:--Dalmatia.
BiblicalUsage: Dalmatia is named once, when Paul writes that Titus has gone there. It is a brief line in a lonely letter, a companion sent out while Paul waits for the end.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the verse shows the spread of the gospel in a single name: the message had reached the far coast, carried by faithful men.
